runtime: Static local assets, decoded in the browser after a user gesture.
validation: This script checks waveforms, clipping, duration, file hashes and loop boundaries. Browser playback is verified separately in tests/audio-browser.mjs. Prompts describe generation intent.

files.prompt: Instrumental background music for a gentle creature evolution island game. Soft marimba, warm wooden flute, lightly plucked nylon strings and a quiet airy pad. A small curious pentatonic melody with plenty of breathing room, calm sunshine, young leaves and a welcoming home. Restrained dynamics, soft transients, repeating natural phrases, unobtrusive game underscore, steady 76 BPM. No vocals, no choir, no spoken words, no dramatic crescendo, no big drums.
files.processing: DC-free gain normalization with peak ceiling; circular cosine crossfade
